items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: This uncle started easing me in professionally... my uncle told me, he says, Oman, you think you can play a couple of tunes for us?

ctx.x: Well, now, is this how you kind of eased in professionally? Well, yes, I would. Right.

This uncle started easing me in professionally because he gave me a lot of encouragement. And, in fact, when I was about twelve years old he took me to a neighborhood show, a neighborhood theater with him. You know, there was the days when they had silent pictures and they used to have an old piano player down in the pit. And then after the picture was over, well, they had a little vaudeville entertainment. Well, this was real great in those days, you know. So the piano player didn't show up. So my uncle and his…
Did they see you accompanying them or was this your spot or what? No, I didn't have a feature spot.
